ninth_hour_darkness.prompt: three crosses standing on the low rocky rise of Golgotha seen from far off, each cross bearing a crucified figure, the whole land swallowed in deep midday darkness, a pale dim sun barely showing through, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

face_on_cross.prompt: a close portrait of the crucified Christ from the shoulders up, his thorn-crowned head lifted, eyes open toward heaven, the rough wooden beam behind his head, dim failing light, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

psalm_scroll_night.prompt: an open scroll of faded illegible script beside a burning clay oil lamp on a rough table at night, warm lamplight, close, vertical, ancient Judea

grace_poured_sky.prompt: warm golden light pouring down like a waterfall from a single break in heavy dark clouds onto the small stone city below, the pouring is the subject, vertical, ancient Judea

nations_turning_wide.prompt: a vast dawn vista of many lands seen from above, plains, desert, river valley and sea coast, small kindreds of every nation in varied period dress all turned and bowing toward one great warm light rising on the shared horizon, vertical

golgotha_hill_wide.prompt: a wide view of three crosses standing on the low rocky rise of Golgotha outside the walls of Jerusalem, the crosses short rough wooden posts, the crucified men stripped to plain loincloths with their feet hanging just above the bystanders' heads, the centre cross bearing the crucified Christ, his bare dark hair against the open sky, a crucified thief stripped to a loincloth on each cross beside him, small mourners standing close below, low stone houses with plain flat earthen roofs beyond the wall, the sky a smooth deep black at midday, the hill and city lying dim in deep shadow, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

look_up_faces.prompt: three different upturned 1st-century faces close together in half-light, eyes lifted toward a warm light above, tears catching the light, hope breaking on the faces, vertical

us_under_cross_shadow.prompt: two bowed figures kneeling small in the dust at dawn, the long shadow of a single cross falling across them and stretching up the ground, heads down and hands clasped, soft low golden light, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

stone_rolled_dawn.prompt: a low rock-cut tomb, its small square opening at ground level pitch dark and empty, the great round stone disc rolled aside, resting against the rock face beside the opening, in a hillside garden at dawn, golden sunrise flooding the garden, vertical, 1st-century Judea

nineveh_distant_walls.prompt: a massive ancient Assyrian walled city on a wide plain at dusk, high square gate towers with plain rectangular gateways, a stepped ziggurat rising within, warm lamplight inside the walls, seen from a distant ridge, vertical, ancient Assyria

kindreds_worship.prompt: a gathering of worshippers of many nations, varied deep and light skin tones, varied period garments and head wraps, kneeling together with hands lifted, heads bowed low or eyes gently closed in reverent awe, one warm column of light falling on their shoulders and lifted hands from above, 1st-century world, vertical

risen_christ_wounds.prompt: the risen Christ standing in radiant dawn light in a garden, white robe, both hands open toward the viewer showing the wounds in his palms, serene living face, vertical, 1st-century Judea

face_on_cross.doctrine: he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross (Phil 2:8)

psalm_scroll_night.subject: open scroll of faded script beside a burning clay oil lamp

grace_poured_sky.subject: golden light pours like a waterfall through broken storm clouds onto a stone city
grace_poured_sky.doctrine: I will pour the spirit of grace (Zech 12:10a)

nations_turning_wide.subject: the kindreds of every land turning toward one rising light
nations_turning_wide.doctrine: all the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD (Psalm 22:27)

look_up_faces.subject: three upturned tearful 1st-century faces catching warm light
look_up_faces.doctrine: they shall look upon me and mourn

us_under_cross_shadow.subject: seven bowed mourners under the long shadow of the cross

nineveh_distant_walls.subject: the walled city of Nineveh at dusk from a distant ridge
nineveh_distant_walls.doctrine: go to Nineveh, that great city (Jonah 1:2)

kindreds_worship.doctrine: all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee (Psalm 22:27)
